title: Ghayal Once Again
desc: The lionhearted Ajay Mehra once again takes up the mantle of justice in a troubled society where the powerful believe they can get away with any crime.

title: Sirf Tum
desc: Deepak and Aarti fall in love with each other without ever meeting each other. Later, Aarti sets out to look for him in the city of Delhi.

title: Prem Granth
desc: Somen, a rich man, falls in love with Kajri, a village belle. However, they get separated when she suddenly leaves for unknown reasons.

title: Chaalbaaz
desc: Anju endures mistreatment at home, whereas her long-separated twin Manju boldly navigates life's challenges. By some quirk of fate, they end up trading places, and their worlds erupt in chaos.

title: Aaj Ka Arjun
desc: A ruthless landlord exiles Bheema due to his rebellion against him. However, when his nephew is abducted, Bheema sets out to gain the support of the villagers and rescue the boy.
